# Kafred Granite & Marble Installation Services

> Lapida (memorial plaque / gravestone marker) engraving maker and granite and marble fabrication and installation service in Burgos, Rodriguez (Montalban), Rizal, Philippines.

- Lettering: engraved script and block typefaces finished in silver, gold, white or black

- Installation: brass standoff fittings or set in place at the gravesite

- Not published (unknown): business hours, email address, founding year, reviews, certifications

## Services
- [Lapida Engraving and Lettering](https://kafredlapida.com/services/#lapida-engraving): Engraving of names, dates, verses and ornaments on granite and marble memorial plaques, with silver, gold, white or black lettering.
- [Custom Lapida and Memorial Stone Work](https://kafredlapida.com/services/#custom-lapida): Memorial plaques designed around the person being remembered, including ceramic photo inserts, laser-etched portraits and family layouts.
- [Granite Fabrication and Installation](https://kafredlapida.com/services/#granite): Black granite, black galaxy granite and blue pearl granite cut, polished, engraved and installed.
- [Marble Fabrication and Installation](https://kafredlapida.com/services/#marble): White and veined marble plaques engraved and installed.
- [Pet Memorials and Other Engraved Stonework](https://kafredlapida.com/services/#other-stonework): Engraved granite and marble plaques for pets, and inquiries for other granite and marble stonework.

## Frequently asked questions
- **What is a lapida?** A lapida is a memorial plaque or gravestone marker, usually made of granite or marble, engraved with the name, dates and a short message for a loved one. Kafred makes lapida in Rodriguez (Montalban), Rizal.
- **What materials do you use for lapida?** We work in black granite, black galaxy granite, blue pearl granite and white marble, including veined marble. Lettering can be finished in silver, gold, white or black.
- **Can a photo be included on the lapida?** Yes. We can add an oval ceramic photo insert or a laser-etched portrait taken from a photograph you provide.
- **Do you install the lapida?** Yes. Kafred fabricates the stone and installs it, either mounted with brass standoff fittings or set in place at the gravesite.
- **Where is Kafred located and which areas do you serve?** The shop is at 63B A. Mabini St., Burgos, Rodriguez (Montalban), Rizal, 1860. We serve Rodriguez, Montalban and nearby areas in Rizal; contact us to confirm installation at your location.
- **How much does a lapida cost?** Each lapida is quoted individually because price depends on the material, size, lettering, portrait work and installation. Call +63 953 084 9511 or message us on Facebook with your details for a quotation.
- **What information do you need to start a lapida order?** The exact names and dates, any epitaph or verse, your preferred material and lettering colour, the approximate size, whether you want a portrait, and where the stone will be installed. We confirm the final text with you before engraving.
- **What is the difference between granite and marble for a lapida?** Granite is dense, holds a high polish and takes a deep, long-lasting engraving, which is why most lapida are granite. Marble is bright and classic and shows black lettering with strong contrast, with natural veining that varies from piece to piece.
- **Can you make a lapida for two people or a whole family?** Yes. We prepare single, double and family layouts, with one or several photo inserts or etched portraits, in horizontal or upright formats.
- **Do you make pet memorial plaques?** Yes. Pet memorials are made in the same granite and marble as our lapida, with a name, dates, a short message and a photo insert if you wish.
- **How do I get a quotation and how long does the work take?** Send the details by phone or Facebook message and we will give you a clear quotation. Timing depends on the design and installation, so we give an honest estimate for your specific order rather than a fixed turnaround.
